town_description: Saitual is a town in Mizoram and the administrative headquarters of Saitual district, about 77 km from Aizawl by road. Founded as a Christian village around 1915 under chief Dorawta Sailo, it became a functional district headquarters on 3 June 2019. It is a predominantly Mizo Christian town with a small non-Mizo Hindu minority.
